knowledge.name: Unit 1 How do we feel? / Explore
Feelings in situations 情境中的心情
knowledge.parent: Unit 1 How do we feel? / Explore
knowledge.explanation: 把心情和情境对应起来：台风、丢东西、走很久、比赛得奖，各自对应 worried / sad / tired / excited 等词。

knowledge.name: Look and feel 系动词后接形容词
knowledge.parent: Unit 1 How do we feel? / Explore
knowledge.explanation: look / feel / smell / taste 是系动词，后面接形容词而不是副词，如 She looks happy、He feels tired。
prerequisites: Feelings in situations 情境中的心情

knowledge.name: Feelings opposites 情绪反义词
knowledge.parent: Unit 1 How do we feel? / Explore
knowledge.explanation: 情绪形容词的反义配对：happy—sad、excited—bored、interested—bored；Why 问原因用 Because 回答。
prerequisites: Feelings in situations 情境中的心情

knowledge.name: Comforting words 安慰用语
knowledge.parent: Unit 1 How do we feel? / Explore
knowledge.explanation: 安慰与鼓励用语：Don't worry. / Cheer up. / It's OK. I can help you.，并说明安慰时要给出具体的帮助。

questions.stem: A typhoon stops school in Shenzhen. Your friend says: "I feel worried." Why?
options: Because he got a new toy.
questions.analysis: worried 是担心，台风要来才会担心，选 A；得到新玩具应开心，阳光明媚与担心无关，喜欢数学也不会让人担心。
questions.knowledge_point: Feelings in situations 情境中的心情

questions.stem: "How does Amy feel?" "She feels ____ because she lost her key."
questions.analysis: 丢了钥匙会难过，选 sad；happy、excited 是高兴、兴奋，proud 是自豪，都与丢东西不符。
questions.knowledge_point: Feelings in situations 情境中的心情

questions.stem: "I feel excited before a football match." shows you are looking forward to it.
questions.analysis: excited 表示兴奋、期待，赛前有这种心情很自然，说法正确。
questions.knowledge_point: Feelings in situations 情境中的心情

questions.stem: Tom feels ____ because he won the race.
questions.analysis: 赢了比赛心情是高兴的，故填 happy；填 sad 与原因相反，填 tired 只说明累，不能对应「赢比赛」。
questions.knowledge_point: Feelings in situations 情境中的心情

questions.stem: Which sentences match the feeling and the reason?
options: Lily feels tired after the long walk.
Lily feels tired because she won a prize.
Ben feels excited about the school trip.
Ben feels excited because he is ill.
questions.analysis: A 走了很久所以累，心情与原因相符 ✓；B 得奖应开心，不是累 ✗；C 期待秋游所以兴奋，相符 ✓；D 生病应难受，不是兴奋 ✗。故 A、C 成立，B、D 不成立。
questions.knowledge_point: Feelings in situations 情境中的心情

questions.stem: Your friend's cat is lost. She looks ____.
questions.analysis: 猫丢了会担心，选 worried；excited 是兴奋，proud 是自豪，hungry 是饿，都不符合情境。
questions.knowledge_point: Feelings in situations 情境中的心情

questions.stem: You look ____ today. Is everything OK?
questions.analysis: look 后接形容词说明状态，tired 是形容词，选 A；tire 是动词或名词，tiring 形容事情累人，tires 是动词形式。
questions.knowledge_point: Look and feel 系动词后接形容词

questions.stem: After look and feel we can use adjectives, as in "She looks happy."
questions.analysis: look、feel 是系动词，后面跟形容词作表语，如 She looks happy，说法正确。
questions.knowledge_point: Look and feel 系动词后接形容词

questions.stem: The soup smells ____. I want more.
questions.analysis: 闻起来不错才会想再喝，故填 nice / good / delicious 均可；填 bad 与「还想再喝」矛盾。
questions.knowledge_point: Look and feel 系动词后接形容词

questions.stem: Which sentences use adjectives correctly after sense verbs?
questions.analysis: A look 后接形容词 happy ✓；B happily 是副词，不能作 look 的表语 ✗；C feel 后接形容词 tired ✓；D tiredly 是副词，用法错误 ✗。故 A、C 成立，B、D 不成立。
questions.knowledge_point: Look and feel 系动词后接形容词

questions.stem: Which word is the opposite of "happy"?
questions.analysis: happy 的反义词是 sad，选 A；excited、proud 都偏积极，calm 是平静，都不是直接反义。
questions.knowledge_point: Feelings opposites 情绪反义词

questions.stem: "Bored" means the opposite of "interested".
questions.analysis: bored 是觉得无聊，interested 是有兴趣，两者意思相反，说法正确。
questions.knowledge_point: Feelings opposites 情绪反义词

questions.stem: He is not sad. He is very ____.
questions.analysis: 与 sad 相反的心情是 happy，故填 happy；填 angry 表示生气，不是 sad 的反义。
questions.knowledge_point: Feelings opposites 情绪反义词

questions.stem: Which pairs are true opposites?
questions.analysis: A 高兴与难过是反义 ✓；B 生气与高兴不是严格反义（生气对应平静或温和）✗；C 兴奋与无聊是反义 ✓；D 累与饿是两种不同状态，不是反义 ✗。故 A、C 成立，B、D 不成立。
questions.knowledge_point: Feelings opposites 情绪反义词

questions.stem: "Why does May look sad?" "____ she misses her friend."
questions.analysis: 问原因用 Why，答句用 Because 引出原因，选 A；So 引出结果，But 表转折，Or 表选择。
questions.knowledge_point: Feelings opposites 情绪反义词

questions.stem: Your classmate is crying. What do you say to comfort her?
options: Don't worry. I can help you.
questions.analysis: 安慰别人用 Don't worry 并表示愿意帮忙，选 A；B 是课堂指令，C 是指责，D 是道别。
questions.knowledge_point: Comforting words 安慰用语

questions.stem: "Cheer up!" is used to encourage someone.
questions.analysis: Cheer up 意为振作起来，用来鼓励别人，说法正确。
questions.knowledge_point: Comforting words 安慰用语

questions.stem: "I feel nervous about the test." "____ up! You studied hard."
questions.analysis: 鼓励别人振作用 Cheer up，故填 Cheer；句首大写首字母，写 cheer 意思正确但不符合句首规范。
questions.knowledge_point: Comforting words 安慰用语

questions.stem: Write two sentences: how your friend feels and one sentence to comfort him or her.

answer.value: He feels sad because he lost his book. Don't worry. I can share mine.

questions.analysis: 评分要点：①用 He / She feels + 情绪词 写出心情（1 分）；②用 because 交代原因（1 分）；③写出一句安慰语，如 Don't worry / Cheer up（1 分）；④句子完整、拼写与标点正确（1 分）。
questions.knowledge_point: Comforting words 安慰用语

questions.stem: A typhoon stops classes in Shenzhen. Write two sentences: how you feel and why.

answer.value: I feel excited because I can stay at home. But I also feel worried about the strong wind.

questions.analysis: 评分要点：①用 I feel + 情绪形容词 写出心情（1 分）；②用 because 说明原因（1 分）；③两句逻辑一致、时态用一般现在时（1 分）；④拼写与标点正确（1 分）。只写心情不写原因扣 1 分。
questions.knowledge_point: Comforting words 安慰用语
